title: Customer-Pay Repairs Pickup Notice: Free Collection Days and Daily Storage Rates
content:
**Customer-Pay Repairs - collecting your vehicle.** Each service tier allows a number of free calendar days to collect the vehicle after the ready date; beyond them storage is billed at the tier's daily rate.

| Service tier | Free calendar days after the ready date | Storage per calendar day beyond the free days (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 3 | 35.00 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 3 | 35.00 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 3 | 40.00 |
| Panel Repair Service | 3 | 45.00 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 3 | 55.00 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 3 | 55.00 |

## Defined terms

- **Free days**: Calendar days after the ready date to collect the vehicle before storage (integer).
- **Daily storage rate**: Storage per calendar day beyond the free days (USD per day).

## Notes

- The free period is 3 calendar days in every tier; only the daily rate differs.
- Hypothetical storage period of 2 billed calendar days: 70.00 at 35.00 a day, 80.00 at 40.00, 90.00 at 45.00, 110.00 at 55.00.
